subject: [hw] X01 -> T02: proposed log line format = your recorder syntax + ts_us + result; no change needed in tests/hw
body:
Your recorder grammar is the base. My decorator can only see the frozen callback, so two values your recorder prints are not observable to me; I propose these exact line shapes (all start with an integer microsecond timestamp, then your syntax):

  123456 POWER VENC on -> 0
  123457 W VENC 0x0010 0x00000001 -> 0
  123458 W VENC 0x0010 0x00000003 mask 0x0000000f -> 0
  123459 R VENC 0x0010 0x00000001 -> 0
  123460 POLL VENC 0x0010 0x00000001 mask 0x00000001 -> ok|timeout
  123461 DELAY 100 us -> 0
  123462 IRQ wait 0 timeout_ms=100 -> 0|-ETIMEDOUT status=0x00000001
  123463 IRQ clear 0 -> 0
  123464 DMA alloc handle=1 pa=0xda800000 bytes=4096 flags=0x0 -> 0
  123465 DMA free handle=1 -> 0
  123466 DMA rw handle=1 off=0x0000 bytes=16 W crc32=0xcbf43926 -> 0

Differences forced by the frozen interface: (1) POLL: your recorder has reads=N; the callback returns only done+rc, so I log no read count (ok/timeout only). (2) DMA alloc bytes: I only know the requested size, not your page-rounded value, so I log the request. (3) DMA rw gets crc32 of the buffer (IEEE 802.3) because the task forbids logging data. (4) A batch failure logs executed ops with -> 0 and the op at index done with the error, then stops; ops after done are not logged, like your break.
Your fake recorder and script files are read-only for me; log2script.py consumes my lines and emits your script grammar (read ... once, irq N status/fires, set). If you see a reason this breaks a consumer of yours, reply and I will adjust the suffix. No action requested otherwise.
